notes.text: Git status performance: combined branch and status into a single git command, halving the number of git.exe processes
Added concurrency limiting for batch git status operations to prevent resource exhaustion on Windows
Button to Star on GIthub and Support for Development
Fixed a race condition in git status fetching that could cause overlapping requests
